description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of domain accounts. This information can help adversaries determine which domain accounts exist on a system to aid in follow-on behavior.
artifacts: RPC endpoint mapper connections (TCP/135) for domain account enumeration
SMB protocol negotiation packets (TCP/445) associated with domain account queries
LDAP queries (TCP/389, TCP/636) for domain user and group enumeration
NetBIOS Session Service (NBSS) traffic on TCP/139 for domain account discovery
RPC calls to SAMR (Security Account Manager Remote) protocol for account enumeration
RPC calls to LSARPC (Local Security Authority Remote) protocol for account enumeration
Domain controller responses containing user and group account information
Sequential or patterned account enumeration behavior
